item.title: Re: General Writing Resource Thread
item.content:encoded:
Random quote I came on today:

Plots are like skeletons, you can't even see them under all the fat and muscle that makes a person. Fat and muscle would be characters and settings. But if your plot is jacked up, people can see that even with the fat and muscle covering it up. "Hey Kas, why do you have an extra arm coming out your ass?" "My maker wanted to be 'different'."

Don't give your stories an ass arm.

item.title: General Writing Resource Thread
item.content:encoded:
This is a general writing resource thread to help each other improve prose and writing in general. Please suggest your own writing resources and I will add them to the list! For guides specific to the site itself, please check our guides hub.

GRAMMAR:
How To Use A Semicolon: An Oatmeal Comic
It's/its And Apostrophe Use: An Oatmeal Comic
How To Use Whom: An Oatmeal Comic
I.E.: An Oatmeal Comic
Speech Tags Guide
Introduction To Basic Punctuation
How to Use Commas / Comma Explanation

CHARACTERIZATION:
Writing A Different Gender Than Your Own
Character Writing Exercises
Using Mental Illness In Writing

PROSE:
HemwingwayApp - Paste your writing and it will highlight weak sentences!
Telling vs Showing In A Picture
Writing the Action Scene - An Essay By David Alexander

GENERAL RESOURCES:
